svg.title: Planes and transformations
svg.desc: Left: a grid with the eigenvectors of A = [[3, 1], [0, 2]] and their spans. A moves the grid, the eigenvectors stretch by 3 and 2 along their own lines, then the grid moves back. Right: a grid of the strip from −1.25 to 0.75 bends under w = e^z, vertical lines rolling into circles and horizontal ones into rays.
